author: VANSMITHLAB
title: BBDO
summary: An advertising agency in New York since 1928. It builds its culture around the quality of the work and the ability of a large network to turn strategy into a simple, broadly legible idea.

hero_image.alt: A cork wall of pinned storyboard frames with people working at it, and a carousel slide projector on the desk in front.
hero_image.caption: The wall as the argument: an idea has to survive being pinned up and read by the room.
